For smooth 4K streaming, you need a minimum of 25 Mbps download speed. For multiple simultaneous 4K streams, aim for 50-100 Mbps.

## Compatible Devices

4K content works on any device with a 4K display and sufficient processing power. Compatible devices include modern Smart TVs, Fire TV Stick 4K, Apple TV 4K, Android TV boxes, and gaming consoles.

## HDR Support

STREAMB4 supports HDR10 and Dolby Vision on compatible devices, delivering exceptional color accuracy and contrast.

## Tips for Best Quality

1. Use a wired ethernet connection when possible
2. Position your router close to your streaming device
3. Disable other bandwidth-heavy applications while streaming
4. Enable 4K resolution in your device settings
5. Ensure your TV supports HDMI 2.0 or higher

title: Fix IPTV Buffering Issues — 10 Proven Solutions for 2026
excerpt: Experiencing IPTV buffering? Here are 10 proven solutions to fix buffering once and for all and enjoy smooth 4K streaming every time.
content:
# Fix IPTV Buffering Issues — 10 Solutions

Buffering is the most common complaint among IPTV users. Here are 10 proven solutions that will eliminate buffering and deliver smooth streaming.

## 1. Upgrade Your Internet Speed

For 4K streaming, you need at least 25 Mbps. For multiple simultaneous streams, aim for 50+ Mbps.

## 2. Use a Wired Connection

Ethernet cables provide more stable connections than WiFi. If possible, connect your streaming device directly to your router.

## 3. Restart Your Router

Simply restarting your router can resolve temporary network issues and improve streaming performance.

## 4. Clear App Cache

Over time, app cache files can slow down your streaming device. Clear the cache regularly for optimal performance.

## 5. Change DNS Settings

Using a faster DNS server like Google (8.8.8.8) or Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) can improve streaming speeds.

## 6. Use a VPN

Some ISPs throttle streaming traffic. A VPN can bypass this throttling and improve streaming performance.

## 7. Reduce Stream Quality

If your connection is unstable, try reducing from 4K to 1080p temporarily.

## 8. Contact STREAMB4 Support

If the issue persists, our 24/7 support team can check your connection and optimize your settings.
